threat_event: A state-sponsored actor exploits a zero-day in the managed file transfer software and exfiltrates CUI program data from the CEE gateway (and corporate files from the separate instance)
threat_source: Foreign intelligence service or contracted cyber actor targeting aerospace suppliers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing file transfer service; same product in two instances; staging folders hold files up to 14 days; no vendor notification commitment
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 CUI exchange gateway; corporate file transfer instance; BP-08
existing_controls: FIPS-mode gateway behind a web application firewall; 24x7 SOC; bulk transfer alerts; 14-day purge
treatment_plan: Purge staging after 72 hours; virtual patching rules at the web application firewall; vendor notification clause; P08 runbook tabletop with the disclosure committee (POAM-019); egress anomaly model for the gateway
key_risk_indicator: Gateway staging volume; mean time to patch internet-facing services; bulk transfer alerts investigated

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing steals an engineer session token and bulk-downloads models from PLM and the CUI suite
threat_source: Foreign intelligence service or contracted cyber actor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Token theft can bypass sign-in MFA; bulk download alerts tuned for suite only, not PLM exports
existing_controls: Hardware security keys; compliant-device checks; token lifetime limits; user behavior analytics
treatment_plan: Token binding for the suite; PLM export volume alert; continuous access evaluation
key_risk_indicator: PLM export alerts; token replay detections

threat_event: A departing engineer copies CUI to personal storage or offers it to a competitor or foreign buyer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3,600 CEE users; data loss prevention covers email and web but not screen capture; adverse information process covers cleared staff only
existing_controls: Data loss prevention; user behavior analytics; exit interviews; insider threat program for cleared staff
treatment_plan: Insider risk program for all CEE users with HR triggers (POAM-022); departure watch lists
key_risk_indicator: Departing users with high download volume; insider cases opened

threat_event: An EAR-licensed foreign-person engineer views ITAR technical data because PLM folders lack export attributes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 folders migrated in 2026-04 lacked the ITAR attribute; one engineer opened 3 files (found 2026-08-11)
existing_controls: Export screening at access grant; attribute-based access in PLM; technology control plans
treatment_plan: Attribute check on every migration; weekly attribute analytics; recertify all foreign-person access; voluntary disclosure handled by the Senior Empowered Official (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: Folders with missing attributes; foreign-person access exceptions

threat_event: Engineers paste CUI into public generative AI or unapproved file-sharing services from corporate devices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public AI blocked inside the CEE but reachable from corporate endpoints; engineers also hold corporate laptops
existing_controls: Approved AI tools list; proxy blocks in the CEE; training
treatment_plan: Extend data loss prevention for CUI markings to corporate endpoints; AI-001 pilot as the approved alternative (P10)
key_risk_indicator: Blocked AI uploads with CUI markings

threat_event: A privileged CEE administrator account is compromised and used to disable logging and export data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 412 privileged users; PAM in place; role-based training 9% overdue
existing_controls: Just-in-time PAM; hardware keys; write-once logs; separate log administrators
treatment_plan: Suspend elevation when training is overdue (POAM-011); quarterly privileged access review
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: An enclave laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 900 enclave laptops travel to primes and suppliers
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption with FIPS-validated modules; remote wipe; virtual desktops for CUI
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption and remote wipe make disclosure unlikely

threat_event: Printed CUI or screens in CUI areas are seen by an unescorted visitor at TX-1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 10 sampled TX-1 visitors had no escort recorded; 2 had no sign-out
existing_controls: Badge access; visitor management system; drawing cabinets
treatment_plan: Escort assignment at check-in; daily reconciliation; host refresher (POAM-003)
key_risk_indicator: Visitor entries without escort or sign-out

threat_event: CUI is exchanged with suppliers over unapproved channels (personal email, consumer file sharing)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway onboarding takes up to 10 days for new suppliers; buyers under schedule pressure
existing_controls: Data loss prevention on corporate email; gateway as the only approved channel
treatment_plan: Onboard new suppliers within 2 business days; monthly data loss prevention review with Supply Chain
key_risk_indicator: Blocked CUI emails to external domains

threat_event: A known vulnerability on a CEE server or virtual desktop image is exploited because it was fixed past SLA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 60 sampled critical and high findings past SLA, mostly in desktop image refreshes
treatment_plan: Weekly desktop image rebuild; SLA dashboard reviewed by the CISO monthly (POAM-009)

threat_event: A cloud provider insider or provider misconfiguration exposes CUI in the government-community tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reliance on provider controls under the CRM
existing_controls: FedRAMP authorization at Moderate or higher; customer-managed keys; U.S.-person support
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk is held by the provider under FedRAMP continuous monitoring; reviewed annually

threat_event: A buyer sends a drawing package to the wrong supplier through the gateway
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 9,800 transfers a week; supplier selection is manual
existing_controls: Gateway recipient confirmation; supplier NDAs and flowdowns
treatment_plan: Recipient check against the purchase order in the gateway

threat_event: The annual CMMC affirmation (due 2027-03-20) cannot truthfully be made because requirements are no longer MET in the certified sites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Score today 80 for the six certified sites (P03); items that cannot be on a POA&M are open (3.10.3, 3.10.4)
affected_asset_or_process: All CEE and MOZ systems; 56% of revenue
existing_controls: Continuous monitoring; POA&M; annual Internal Audit assessment
treatment_plan: Close all certified-site gaps by 2027-02-28; readiness re-check before the affirmation
key_risk_indicator: Requirements NOT MET in the certified scope

threat_event: The company cannot reach Level 3 (DIBCAC) status in time for the Program H solicitation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 10 of 24 Level 3 requirements met; scope undecided; prerequisite Level 2 assessment of the expanded scope
treatment_plan: Scope decision 2026-12-15; readiness program (POAM-021); Level 2 assessment of the expanded scope 2027-05; DIBCAC request 2027-06

threat_event: Work on a contract that includes DFARS 252.204-7021 is performed on KS-1 systems that have no CMMC status
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 1 of 30 sampled work orders for 7021 contracts routed to KS-1 (2026-08)
existing_controls: Routing rule in ERP for 7021 contracts
treatment_plan: Hard block in ERP and MES routing; contract review with the Vice President, Contracts; accelerate KS-1 migration (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: 7021 work orders routed to sites without status

threat_event: The KS-1 SPRS entry (72, 2025-01-28) overstates current implementation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recalculated KS-1 score is -14 (P03)
treatment_plan: Post a corrected score with a date to reach 110 (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: SPRS entries older than 12 months or not matching current state

threat_event: A DIBCAC or prime assessment under DFARS 252.204-7020 finds requirements not met and its results take precedence over the current status
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operating exceptions in P07; AZ-1 not yet assessed
treatment_plan: Same remediation as R-013; evidence binder kept current
key_risk_indicator: Open POA&M items in the certified scope

threat_event: A new site, line, or system starts handling CUI before a scope change is approved and assessed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AZ-1 joined the CEE after certification; scope change procedure new in 2026-05
treatment_plan: Scope gate in capital project approvals

threat_event: The government-community cloud offering loses its FedRAMP authorization or changes terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single provider for all CUI services
existing_controls: Annual Marketplace check; contract notice clause
treatment_plan: Accepted: low likelihood; exit plan documented

threat_event: Inaccurate cybersecurity representations to DoD (SPRS, affirmations) create False Claims Act exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Affirmations and SPRS entries depend on current evidence; KS-1 entry is out of date
existing_controls: Legal review of affirmations; Internal Audit testing
treatment_plan: Affirmation evidence pack reviewed by Internal Audit and the General Counsel before each submission

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from corporate IT into the MOZ and stops MES and DNC at several plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MOZ isolated at 6 sites; shared identity services; flat KS-1 network
existing_controls: Segmentation; EDR; immutable backups; MES standby in DC-2
treatment_plan: Close AZ-1 and KS-1 segmentation gaps (POAM-005; POAM-020); annual OT recovery exercise
key_risk_indicator: Unsegmented OT segments; OT recovery test results

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the KS-1 legacy file server, MES, and their local backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat network; weekly backups in the same building; legacy MES end of support 2027-06
treatment_plan: Daily offsite backups for KS-1 now; migration into CEE and MOZ by 2027-03-31 (POAM-020)

threat_event: Malware reaches an AZ-1 printer or build-prep workstation through a USB drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: USB-only path to printers; 6 of 25 sampled transfers skipped the kiosk
treatment_plan: Controlled transfer service to printers (POAM-006)

threat_event: A DC-1 outage stops MES, ERP, and the quality system at several plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standby in DC-2 tested at 6.5 hours
treatment_plan: Accepted: failover met its RTO in 2026-03

threat_event: A hurricane damages Florida sites (FL-1, FL-2, FL-3, DC-1)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three plants and the primary data center in one state
treatment_plan: Property and business interruption insurance; pre-storm failover to DC-2
key_risk_indicator: Days to restore after storm exercises

threat_event: A regional outage at the government-community cloud makes PLM and the CUI suite unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Second region in the same offering
treatment_plan: Accepted: plants keep running on MES

threat_event: A printer manufacturer remote support session at AZ-1 is hijacked to reach the build-prep network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manufacturer tool outside PAM without company MFA or recording
existing_controls: Firewall allows only the manufacturer endpoint
treatment_plan: Move to the PAM vendor gateway; block the tool (POAM-008)

threat_event: An ERP outage halts shipping documents and invoicing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standby in DC-2
treatment_plan: Accepted: met RTO in test

threat_event: A CUI supplier without the CMMC status its subcontract needs receives CUI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Status verified for 176 of 380 CUI suppliers; Phase 2 begins 2026-11-10
existing_controls: Supplier questionnaires; SPRS checks for new awards since 2025-11
treatment_plan: Verify all 380 in SPRS; block CUI release in the gateway to suppliers without verified status (POAM-018)
key_risk_indicator: Share of CUI suppliers with verified status

threat_event: A supplier breach exposes company CUI held by the supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 380 suppliers hold drawings; limited visibility of their controls
existing_controls: Flowdowns require suppliers to report to DoD and give the incident number
treatment_plan: Supplier incident intake procedure; minimum data shared per purchase order

threat_event: Purchase orders that send CUI omit DFARS 252.204-7012 and 252.204-7021 flowdowns
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 60 sampled purchase orders lacked the clauses
treatment_plan: ERP enforces the clause set on any purchase order flagged CUI (POAM-018)

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a trusted CAD, PLM, or file transfer software update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor updates run with high privileges
existing_controls: Staged rollout; code signing checks on endpoints
treatment_plan: Signature verification for server software; supply chain plan for system components (POAM-023)

threat_event: A vendor fails to tell the company about a critical vulnerability in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No notification commitments in key software contracts (P05 DEP-09)
treatment_plan: Add notification clauses to tier-1 software contracts at renewal

threat_event: Counterfeit or tampered network equipment enters the CEE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Purchases through authorized channels only
treatment_plan: Accepted: purchasing controls in place

threat_event: A cyber incident at the sole-source titanium forging supplier delays Prime A deliveries
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 70% of forgings from one supplier with no cyber assurance evidence
treatment_plan: Supplier cyber review; second source qualification (2027)

threat_event: An external service provider with Security Protection Data mishandles credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 manufacturer remote access paths
treatment_plan: Same as R-027; annual ESP review

threat_event: A prime supplier portal is compromised and used to send malicious files to engineers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers trust prime portal content
existing_controls: Files opened only in virtual desktops with EDR
treatment_plan: Detonation of prime files in the gateway sandbox

threat_event: Covered telecommunications equipment is found in the KS-1 network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: KS-1 inventory not fully reviewed
treatment_plan: Review the KS-1 inventory by 2026-11-30; report within 1 business day if found

threat_event: An altered NC program or additive build file produces a nonconforming flight part
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrity checks on PLM releases; no integrity verification on MES and DNC servers
existing_controls: PLM checksums; first article inspection; separation of duties
treatment_plan: Checksum verification at DNC and printer load (POAM-021)

threat_event: A wrong drawing revision reaches the shop floor because of a PLM to MES sync error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nightly sync; manual overrides allowed
treatment_plan: Real-time sync with reconciliation report

threat_event: An AI-001 output with a wrong numeric value reaches a released engineering document
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pre-expansion test found 2 wrong numeric values in 200 answers (P10)
existing_controls: Checker sign-off; numbers copied from source only
treatment_plan: Pilot rules and monitoring (P10); quality nonconformance process

threat_event: Inspection data from a CMM is altered or lost and a part is accepted in error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CMM results stored on local PCs before upload
treatment_plan: Accepted: daily upload and sign-off

threat_event: Additive build parameters change at AZ-1 without change control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Build-prep workstations without baseline; local administrator rights
existing_controls: Build parameter sign-off by process engineers
treatment_plan: Baseline and parameter lock on build-prep workstations (POAM-004)

threat_event: The GA-1 autoclave controllers, which run an unsupported operating system, fail or are compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 controllers; isolated segment; replacement 2027
existing_controls: Isolated segment; chart recorders; outsourcing agreement
treatment_plan: Accepted until replacement in 2027-06 (exception EXC-2026-011)

threat_event: KS-1 legacy directory accounts of departed staff stay active
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy directory not connected to HR
treatment_plan: Federate KS-1 users into SYS-01 before migration

threat_event: CUI on the KS-1 legacy file server is exfiltrated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat network; no MFA on local access; logs not in SIEM
existing_controls: EDR; SOC monitoring of EDR alerts
treatment_plan: Migrate CUI by 2027-03-31; interim MFA and SIEM forwarding (POAM-020)

threat_event: AZ-1 printer segment, reachable from the corporate network, is used to reach build files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Segment reachable over file-sharing ports
treatment_plan: Isolate the segment (POAM-005)
key_risk_indicator: Open paths from corporate to OT

threat_event: A future acquisition closes without cyber due diligence and brings CUI outside the scope
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: KS-1 experience; no CMMC gate in deal process until 2026-07
treatment_plan: CMMC and export due diligence required before signing

threat_event: An intrusion at KS-1 goes undetected because KS-1 logs are not in the SIEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only EDR alerts monitored
treatment_plan: Forward KS-1 server and firewall logs to the SIEM (POAM-020)

threat_event: A material incident is disclosed late or inaccurately, or the 8-K draft discloses CUI or classified details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Playbook exercised only with ransomware; no content review step; no Attorney General delay path
treatment_plan: Add data-theft scenario, content review, and delay path; tabletop 2026-11-19 (POAM-019)

threat_event: A required DDTC or BIS voluntary disclosure decision is late or undocumented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure process exists; one decision pending (R-004)
existing_controls: Senior Empowered Official reviews within 5 days
treatment_plan: Track the full disclosure due 60 days after the 2026-08-19 initial notification

threat_event: A supplier-originated incident affecting company CUI is not reported to DoD within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplier notices arrive by email; 2 of 25 sampled incidents lacked a recorded reportability decision
treatment_plan: Reportability decision field mandatory in the case system (POAM-017)

threat_event: A cyber incident on the classified information system is not reported immediately to DCSA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Stand-alone system; ISSM trained
treatment_plan: Accepted: strong existing controls

threat_event: Adverse information about a cleared employee is not reported to DCSA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Managers unaware of duties
treatment_plan: Manager briefing on reporting duties

threat_event: Employee personal information is breached and state notice deadlines are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Employees in 6 states plus remote staff; 30-day Florida clock
affected_asset_or_process: Payroll and benefits data; corporate file transfer
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
treatment_plan: Multi-state notification procedure in P08

threat_event: The Item 106 disclosure does not match actual practice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Description drafted from policy
treatment_plan: Internal Audit tests each Item 106 statement before filing

threat_event: Images and logs that DoD may request are lost before 90 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Preservation procedure exists; forensic retainer
treatment_plan: Accepted: procedure tested in 2026-04 drill

threat_event: An ERP access deficiency becomes a SOX control deficiency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly certification in place
treatment_plan: Accepted: no deficiencies in 2025 testing

threat_event: AI-001 surfaces CUI to users who lack need-to-know because suite permissions are too broad
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Permission audit found 46 of 410 sites open to all CEE users (P10)
treatment_plan: Permission clean-up before expansion (P10)

threat_event: AI-001 is enabled for a foreign-person user and returns ITAR data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot group managed by hand
existing_controls: Pilot excludes foreign persons; PLM attributes
treatment_plan: Pilot group driven by the export screening attribute

threat_event: AI use cases run without AI governance committee review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 12 use cases not reviewed (P10)
regulatory_driver: Texas Bus. & Com. Code 552.056 (for AI-009); Title VII
treatment_plan: Review all 4 by 2026-11-30 (POAM-024)

threat_event: The composite panel inspection vision model misses a defect
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model assists inspectors; ultrasonic inspection remains
treatment_plan: Monthly miss-rate monitoring (P10)

threat_event: The resume screening tool produces adverse impact for a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Ranking feature; no adverse impact analysis yet
regulatory_driver: Title VII (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k)); Texas Bus. & Com. Code 552.056
treatment_plan: Ranking feature turned off pending review and adverse impact analysis

threat_event: A vendor switches on AI features in a SaaS tool without intake review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature releases arrive without notice
treatment_plan: Contract clause requiring notice of AI features
